Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the reporting of highway construction project errors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the reporting of highway construction projecterrors; and adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall submit a report to the legislature detailingengineering errors on highway construction projects resulting inproject cost increases in excess of five hundred thousand dollars. (1) The department's report must include an assessment and reviewof: (a) How the engineering error happened; (b) Who was responsible for the engineering error; and (c) What disciplinary action was taken. (2) If the error resulted in a project cost increase in excess ofone million dollars, the report must also assess: (a) Why the responsible department employee or employees were notterminated; and (b) What action the secretary recommends to avoid similar errors inthe future. p. 1 HB 1986 (3) If the legislature finds that the actions taken by thesecretary were inadequate, the legislature may take additional actionto correct the problem.
